result.question: Why did Uzziah build watch towers?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert

assessments.reason: The text says, “Since he had much livestock… he built towers in the desert,” tying the towers to his livestock; the key’s “He loved farming” matches the separate clause about having farmers and vinedressers, not the towers.

result.reason: The passage links Uzziah’s tower-building to his having much livestock, not to his love of farming.
